rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.description: The Elo rankings of this game's players and clans, format by format.
rankings.howItWorks: Each format has its own ranking, where everyone starts at 1000 points. Each confirmed fight wins or loses up to 32: beating a higher-rated opponent is worth more. In a team, every player wins or loses what the fight was worth to the team. A clan is ranked on its teams' fights and, in 1v1, on its members' duels against other clans' members.
